severity_definitions.critical: Wrong key, grading that misgrades most learners, or the item teaches false content as correct.
severity_definitions.high: The item cannot measure its objective; a pass gate depends on untaught content; feedback states something false; a strong test-wiseness cue (key at least 2x the next-longest option or an equivalent giveaway); or a specification contradiction that enables a banned practice.
severity_definitions.medium: Weakened validity, transfer or grading reliability; graders could disagree; tests accept specific wrong answers or reject legitimate ones while the rubric or other items partly mitigate.
severity_definitions.low: Polish, metadata or minor wording issues with no material effect on scores.

scorecard_scale.concern: medium or low defect, or a weak point below defect threshold
scorecard_scale.fail: high or critical defect on this criterion

defects.proposed_correction: Add an evidence-strength field (strong: chosen distractor, produced defect, or diagnostic value; weak: omission or optional criterion) and let only strong evidence trigger the misconception feedback layer. SME-07 to rule per link. No patch (schema change).
